evidence: Quick Design-only backend review of specs/spec.md, design/design.md, and design/contract.json. The design otherwise defines closed trust-boundary validation, serialized budget admission, one finalization lock, CAS publication, and idempotent crash reconciliation. One terminal multi-write contract is internally ambiguous.

findings.issue: The finalization write set is not closed: surface_ids already counts exports_terminal_evidence among the eight surfaces, but prepare requires all eight surface projections plus a redacted exports projection.
findings.why: A backend coordinator cannot implement or validate atomic multi-write completion deterministically when the contract permits either eight writes with exports included or nine writes with exports separate; one interpretation can leave an untracked projection outside the complete digest set.
findings.suggestion: Define one canonical write set. Prefer stating that the eight surface_ids include the redacted exports projection, derive prepare/commit/reconcile and the digest set from that enumeration, and test that no ninth projection exists outside it.
